{{Quote|Time to see who's smart enough to join the hunt. Open fire!|Garnac's orders that caused Morgo's death|audio=Garnac-Openfire.flac|<ref name="PL" />}}
'''Morgo''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] with [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|secessionists]].<ref name="PL" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Morgo was kidnapped by a [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|group]] of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] to be [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for sport, and placed in a [[Prison/Legends|cell]] on a [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|slave ship]]<ref name="PL" /> called the ''[[Vermin-Thrax/Legends|Vermin-Thrax]]''<ref name="Veh">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="PL" /> the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Lika/Legends|Lika]], the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]], and the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Vadoo/Legends|Vadoo]].<ref name="PLEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref>

Morgo and the other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were taken to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] and dropped out of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] onto an [[Island Four/Legends|island]] [[Beach/Legends|beach]]. The Trandoshan leader [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]] opened the [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|hunt]] by ordering his subordinate [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] to shoot at the prisoners from the ship's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. Morgo attempted to run to safety but covered little ground before being hit by the [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="PL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morgo first appeared unnamed in "[[Padawan Lost]],"<ref name="PL" /> the twenty-first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series that aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]]. The Selkath was later named in the accompanying episode guide published on [[StarWars.com]], which also revealed that Morgo was modeled after [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]],<ref name="PLEG" /> another Selkath character who appeared in an earlier episode in the season, "[[Pursuit of Peace]]."<ref name="PP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> The character model for [[Mantu/Legends|Mantu]], a different Selkath who later appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Season Four]] episode "[[The Box]]," was based upon Morgo's model.<ref name="TBEG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep417|text="The Box" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
